senses.definition: A drug, p-[(alpha-ethoxy-p-phenylphenacyl)amino]-benzoic acid, with antiviral activity.
The powerful oxidizing agent H₂XeO₄ formed by the dissolution of xenon trioxide in water
An electric lamp that makes a very bright light by shooting electricity through pressurized xenon gas.
a crystalline substance, XeF₂, used as a fluorinating agent and oxidizing agent in various surface modification processes, and as an etching agent in semiconductor production
A lamp that produces a very short, but very intense, flash of white light; used in photography and in photocoagulation
The first compound of an inert gas to be prepared; it seems to have the formula XePtF₆, but its structure is ambiguous, and may be a mixture.
A xenon arc lamp or xenon flash lamp.
A chemical compound with the chemical formula C₁₈H₁₈O₂.
A recently extinct species of gossamer-winged butterfly (Lycaenidae), Glaucopsyche xerces.
senses.example: Last seen at the Presidio, the Xerces blue finally passed from existence in 1943.

senses.definition: A red-orange pigment and precursor to variegatic acid, found in fungi of the order Boletales.
A rare genetic disorder in which DNA damaged by ultraviolet light is not repaired and the skin becomes sensitive to such light, in which a skin cancer can subsequently develop.
An acid with chemical formula C₈H₁₂O₄, related to fumaric acid.
senses.example: The empirical formula of xeronic acid shows that it is homologous with citraconic acid, but it possesses properties very different from this, inasmuch as it does not combine either
